extension_points: Handwritten entity schema/registrations generate mechanical enumeration and persistent record codecs.
Entity-specific validation/deletion rules live in schema/features, never the generic coordinator.
state_failure_version_rules: This is an L1 draft design contract: no compiled public consumer, BP execution, L2 integration or capability completion is asserted by this file.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Validation rejects missing/type/unit/range/ref/future-version inputs without model/history changes.
Type/field persistent IDs do not depend on registrar order.
A new optional field has an explicit old-schema default; incompatible changes require migration.
Undo/redo and persistence traverse the same declared field/ref representation.
